verdict.rationale: Otter documents ways to get data out: exporting transcripts, summaries, and metadata to your own Amazon S3 bucket, auto-sync to Airtable, and a public API with webhooks that lets meeting data connect to any system. These are integration and sync paths, though, not a documented full-account export in named open formats for leaving the service. Missing for 10: an explicit bulk 'export all my data' feature, documented open file formats (e.g. TXT/SRT/JSON), export of the original audio/video recordings, offboarding/account-deletion guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
